extraction.name: LAMBADA dataset
extraction.description: A dataset for evaluating word prediction requiring a broad discourse context, built from narrative passages where humans can guess the last word from the full passage but not from the last sentence alone.
extraction.creator: Denis Paperno, Germán Kruszewski, Angeliki Lazaridou, Quan Ngoc Pham, Raffaella Bernardi, Sandro Pezzelle, Marco Baroni, Gemma Boleda, Raquel Fernández
extraction.rai:dataCollection: LAMBADA was constructed from the Book Corpus by randomly dividing novels into training and development+testing partitions, filtering passages with several language models, and then using human subjects on CrowdFlower to verify that the target word could be guessed from the full passage but not from the target sentence alone.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Software Collection, Manual Human Curator, Web API
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The dataset is built around passages with a missing target word; passages were excluded if the target word was guessable from local context alone.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Narrative passages from the Book Corpus (unpublished novels), after duplicate removal and filtering out potentially offensive material with a stop word list.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Passages were filtered using language models; any passage whose target word had probability >= 0.00175 according to any of the language models was excluded. The remaining passages were then screened by human subjects in a multi-step crowdsourcing pipeline, and only items meeting strict hit-or-miss criteria were kept.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Duplicate removal and filtering of potentially offensive material; selection of passages with at least 50 tokens in the context; exclusion of passages easy for language models; removal of passages not meeting human-guessability criteria; vocabulary restricted to the 60K most frequent words for modeling experiments.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Human subjects on CrowdFlower guessed the target word from the whole passage in two consecutive steps; if both guesses were correct, additional subjects guessed the target word from the target sentence only. A passage was added only if no subject could guess the target word from the sentence alone.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Two consecutive subjects had to exactly match the missing word, and up to ten subjects in the sentence-only condition were allowed three guesses each. The same subject was not allowed to judge the same item in both passage and sentence conditions.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: At least 2 passage-level judgments plus up to 10 sentence-only judgments; sentence-only subjects were allowed 3 guesses each.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Human subjects; no further demographic information reported.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: A pre-trained recurrent neural network (RNN), a 4-gram model, an RNN, and a feed-forward model were used as automated filters; additional models used in experiments included RNN, LSTM, N-gram, cache N-gram, Memory Network, Sup-CBOW, and Unsup-CBOW.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The development set and training corpus were made available at the project website; the test set was to be released at the time of the competition. No further maintenance or versioning policy is described.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No explicit collection of sensitive human attributes is described; the paper notes filtering of potentially offensive material and discusses proper nouns, pronouns, and other linguistic categories in the text.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to encourage development of models that genuinely understand broad discourse context and to support a public competition for research on language understanding.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is biased toward proper nouns and contains a high proportion of quoted direct speech; target words are often present in the context, and nouns are overrepresented relative to verbs, adjectives, and adverbs.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: LAMBADA is a challenging benchmark by design and standard language models are expected to fail on it. It is limited to English narrative passages from novels and may not generalize beyond this domain; the strict filtering and exact-match criteria may exclude plausible alternative continuations.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluation of word prediction and broad-context language understanding; intended as a challenging test set for training, development, fine-tuning, and testing of language models, with the development set usable for fine-tuning.
